verification.validation: Focused release checks cover daemonctl with the race detector, the Linux arm64 daemonctl cross-build, documentation, generated versions, the executor manifest, and npm package builds. The extended gate has a pre-existing Node release fixture failure on main. No NAS acceptance or executor rebuild.

changes: SDK-managed daemons rotate daemon/daemon.log at up to 4 MiB and keep one previous file, daemon/daemon.log.1. Oversized existing logs are trimmed to their most recent 4 MiB at the next daemon start.
When the log queue fills or a log write fails, the daemon supervisor drops output and reports the dropped byte count as DAEMON_LOG_DROPPED when writes resume.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 with the same release digests.
